name: trip-map
description: Tools for building and testing the Trip Map app.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run lint && node tools/build-site.ts
scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check "src/**/*.ts" "tools/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" "*.ts" eslint.config.js "css/**/*.css" index.html && node tools/check-headers.ts
